title: Geometric interpretation and error structure of the $Q$-value decomposition
html:
Geometric interpretation

Each factor in Q reads geometrically:

See Table 3.

The ratio \hbar_q / \ln q = 0.9496 is the discretisation correction. The exceptional divisors are q-spaced (discrete), not e-spaced (continuous).

Error structure

Let \varepsilon = \delta q / q \approx 1.2 \times 10^{-8} (CODATA). The parametric error is O(\varepsilon), which is negligible. The structural errors are O(1) relative to \varepsilon: at z = q^3/(q^2+1) they range from 8–98\% for \mathcal{Q}_{\mathrm{bare}} and 1–100\% for the combined formula across the six benchmark decays tabulated in the interpretation. These residuals arise from nucleon ordering in \mathcal{Q}_{\mathrm{bare}}, degree-2 Rosso--Jones weighting over two knots, degree-tower truncation, and, for filled shells, the vanishing of the (1^3) Pauli branch at z = q^3/(q^2+1). Whether the decomposition is complete is a separate claim; these residuals do not test it.
